definitions.gloss: unsightly; ugly; unattractive to look at
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is unpleasant or embarrassing to look at in terms of physical appearance.
Describes behavior or conduct that is embarrassing, undignified, or beneath acceptable standards.

examples.japanese: {見苦|みぐる}しい⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かけないで→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: Don't go out looking so unkempt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見苦|みぐる}しくて⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧。
examples.english: My room is such a mess that I'm embarrassed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{見苦|みぐる}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せたくない→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to show an unsightly appearance in front of others.

examples.japanese: {見苦|みぐる}しい⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧はやめろ。
⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{文句|もんく}を{言|い}う→文句を言う：21303_monkuwoiu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見苦|みぐる}しい。
⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見苦|みぐる}しい⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦うんざりしている→うんざりする：20665_unzarisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm fed up with the unseemly squabbling of politicians.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (seeing) and ⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧ (painful, difficult). Literally "painful to look at." The behavioral sense (sense 2) is the more commonly used in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見苦|みぐる}しい⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧: pathetic excuses
- {見苦|みぐる}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: an unsightly/disgraceful appearance
- {見苦|みぐる}しい⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧: unseemly behavior
- {見苦|みぐる}しい⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: disgraceful squabbling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{醜|みにく}い→醜い：00281_minikui⟧: ugly — focuses on physical ugliness; stronger and more blunt
- ⟦{情|なさ}けない→情けない：03129_nasakenai⟧: pathetic, pitiful — emphasizes disappointment and pity
- ⟦{聞|き}き{苦|ぐる}しい→聞き苦しい：23247_kikigurushii⟧: hard to listen to, grating — the auditory equivalent of {見苦|みぐる}しい
